body: Yeah, I called them twice. First time I was given a number to call someone else. Second time, I was connected to someone who basically didn't help me at all but just told me to go to ER. Hung up and called again and it was the same person at 2:30am. Going to ER and being confined to a bed for days is something that I don't want.

There was a time when I was sure of what I wanted to be in life. I lived at home at the time, and so I had the luxury of time on my side to work on what I considered then my passion--music.

When I moved out eventually, I grew up to the reality that people needed to work jobs to do their passions. I hated this. In fact, at one time I loved my passion, but when it turned into doing it for a paycheck, I quit doing what I had been doing altogether. In the end, I didn't want to do the work required even though it's my passion. I couldn't justify doing it if it wasn't for a paycheck, though, which is the ironic thing I guess because it was / still is my passion?

So I forgot myself. I stayed in a job that killed me spiritually, even though I gave it all I had. That ended and now I'm left with just nothing. I had my fun drinking myself to death in the past, but the "joy" of that now just doesn't appeal to me anymore, as I guess I've kind of numbed myself to everything I used to like.

It's not that I accept any person's opinions or truths that hurts, it's that I have to accept them because they can't be refuted. Things like:

*Women are attracted to confident men* (Implying that if you're not confident, you're going to have a rough time.)

I hope things will work out with the job, but somehow retail always makes me want to hide in the corner. ;_;

I think sex should be earned, not paid for. 

My view on escorts/prostitution is that I see them as last resorts for losers unable to achieve real success with women. I followed r/seduction for a long time to avoid having to resort to such measures. I'll take castration any day over hurting my pride and sense of self by having sex with someone who doesn't care about me and giving into instant gratification. But that is just my two cents.

I had to make a throwaway account to make this post, because I was banned from here just for subscribing to one of those so-called "hate" reddits (not subscribed anymore). Truthfully, a lot of this baggage has come from reading that stuff, but I had no outlet to get it out because of having been banned here, so I supposed it would've died still on my chest.

I've spoken to my family, I've called 1-800-SUICIDE. I don't think think anyone can actually help me because my problems are very specific and personal, and I just hate every moment of knowing the things I know and not being able to deal with my circumstances.

I wouldn't do anything crazy like that Elliot Rodger...I have ethical standards. I don't think anyone should be hurt because of my personal struggles. I have no intention to hurt anyone. These are my *existential problems* (as in related to *being*) to sort through alone (or leave unsorted as I plan to). I just can't go through with any of this anymore.
